text:
The colts are already drawing near; swiftly

the group defines its contours of wild beauty;

through the pale rose of the languid landscape

they run unbridled, level with the breeze.


The colts are drawing near: but they do it so fast,

that they seem to fly over the quiet place;

their hooves move in a fantastic journey,

leaving behind huts of imprecise silhouette.


Hurricane-like over the native plains,

the fugitive colts go devouring leagues,

to mock the efforts of useless pursuit;


like a winged shadow they pass before us,

and the sturdy farmhands, fleeing after the colts,

draw flourishes in the wind with their lassos...

translation.title: The Colts
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the galloping visual energy and the lassos writing in the air.
